entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's so extravagant... to the point that it's[n]gaudy.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, a Palace is a world formed by a[n]mind twisted by desire—remember[n]Kamoshida's castle?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Madarame's artwork is on display at[n]museums in reality too, though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: His exhibit was popular, and people[n]already respect him. Why would he[n]fantasize about a museum?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got a point... It ain't related to[n]plagiarism or abuse, either.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's try looking around. Racking our[n]brains here won't do us any good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That aside... Ain't a museum a must for[n]phantom thieves!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now that's our Joker. I feel the same.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. All those old man's fans were[n]super strong and all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That has nothing to do with this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man, just look at that insane crowd...
